timing_boundary: two clock reads around unchanged harness once-wrapper; no overhead subtraction; record construction after ending read
setup_policy: fresh explicit session/setup for EVERY warmup/formal trial; setup counted separately, never amortized
schedule: serial round-robin; rotate initial configuration by round modulo 10; all warmup rounds precede all formal rounds
randomness: OSBits/secrets.randbits; fresh full-domain samples; no deterministic seed; exact rejection with full traces
trace_policy: complete traces retained through each trial; raw export stores counts, not private blocks; artifacts released after logging

gc.policy: unchanged Python automatic GC; no forced collections inside phases

phase_contracts.group_setup: Warm provider constructor; Waters exact nonzero beta plus n+1 full scalars, h/U multiplication and validation; Okamoto exact nonzero b, h multiplication and import validation; global exponents/traces not exported.
phase_contracts.ca_keygen: Fresh full-domain secret sampling, mu, secret/public encoding, complete private trace tuple.
phase_contracts.ca_import: Decode/validate existing secret, recompute mu/Y, create fixed SHAKE hash, context/challenge guards and fresh service state; distinct from key generation.
phase_contracts.user_prepare: Fresh full-domain user sampling, mu, canonical request and secret encoding, complete private traces.
phase_contracts.issue: Canonical wire request/member validation before random bits; full nonce sampling/traces, KC/R/C, fixed SHAKE hash, response, issued/private state and encoded outputs.
phase_contracts.completion: Certificate parse/member validation; decode both user/response secrets (including Waters relation); fixed H, secret operations and canonical secret output.
phase_contracts.reconstruction: Certificate parse/member validation, fixed H, public operations AND canonical public output encoding.
phase_contracts.preimage_validation: fresh=False; full internal reconstruction, secret decode/member validation, mu, canonical equality; does not reuse the separately reconstructed public value.

hash.rule: first lambda output bits as integer, plus 1; complete C bytes; no hash cache
hash.model: fixed deterministic H; concrete tests are not ROM security

scope.provider_imports: already imported/warm; excluded from every phase; no cold-start claim
scope.setup_reuse: one explicit setup per session/configuration; reused by its trials; independent sessions by default per mode
scope.freshness: fresh CA/user/nonce and fresh service per trial; verify_preimage fresh=False
scope.source_initialization: bits_factory(context) is inside the consuming setup/keygen/user/issue phase
scope.cache_policy: no harness application hash/point-validation/pairing cache or cross-certificate precomputation; interpreter/provider warm and their intrinsic behavior retained
scope.trace_policy: complete immutable CA/user/nonce traces retained privately; summaries/trace exports/JSON/source hashing outside phase calls; no global setup trace or exponent export
scope.diagnostics: cheap result-shape checks and success classification occur outside phase callables, without duplicate secret decoding or group operations
scope.legacy_guard: PS/Waters use a harness-local exact-int/range guard around unchanged FixedHash/core; legacy source modules are not modified
scope.Waters_setup: n=8; h plus nine U points included even though no signatures are executed; certificate id is separately 128 bits
scope.Okamoto_setup: fresh nonzero b and H=bG1, including public-import validation; empty aux; public provider also exposes G2/GT/pairing
scope.runner_contract: exactly one callable invocation and unchanged returned object; failure retained; no rollback or adversarial runner isolation
scope.failure_policy: retain phase/error and skipped successors; no silent sample deletion; repeated setup/trial IDs rejected
scope.accounting: keygen and import both compute Y; separately report actual costs. Recon and full preimage validation are alternative verifier workflows; never add recon twice
scope.pp_encoding: public metadata only; no complete serialized pp wire-size claim
scope.GQ: static source-separated comparison only; no execution
scope.signatures: not executed; no composed-signature security claim
scope.clock: none; no formal performance trials/statistics; no bit-time or constant-time claim

interpretation: not native W2 replay or historical R7 reproduction
fixed concrete hash, not ROM instantiation
